item.title: How to apply NOC online?
item.dc:creator: bipin.sharma
item.content:encoded:
Are you worried about how to apply NOC online? You may also be wondering if there is an online portal to submit your application? What is the procedure to apply for NOC online? What are the documents required to apply for NOC online? YouTube Video: Step-by-Step NOC Online Tutorial - [embed]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ykr72lbXsHQ&t=456s[/embed] These are the questions most of us have in our minds before applying for NOC. The process to lodge your NOC online application isn’t that complicated. If you follow the step by step guide mentioned below in this article, you would be able to obtain your NOC letter in Nepal online. Most of us are still unaware of NOC. Why and when should you obtain NOC? Let’s understand, what is NOC and who should apply and obtain NOC?

What is a No Objection Certificate (NOC)?

NOC is a letter provided by the Ministry of Education, Science, and Technology to all Nepali students who have finished their degree in Nepal or abroad and got an equivalency certificate from Nepal and intend to continue their studies overseas.
If you haven't obtained an equivalence of your foreign degree, click here to know the step-by-step procedure.

Why do you need to obtain NOC?

You applied to universities abroad and got accepted in one of the programs you applied for and successfully received the offer letter. Now, to accept and move forward with the offer letter you need to pay the fees mentioned in your offer letter to a university abroad.  One of the most common ways to transfer your fees from Nepal to abroad is to do a SWIFT transfer via one of the commercial banks. The bank will demand NOC with you in order to transfer your fees to the university. Therefore, having NOC means two important things
    • A person who is entitled to the NOC letter is not on a government-provided scholarship, and the government has no issue with them travelling overseas to study on university-provided scholarships or with fully paid tuition.
    • You have the legal right to send or pay your tuition fees in foreign currency to a foreign university for educational purposes
Since you understand what NOC is and why you need to obtain NOC. Let’s look into the documents you may need to apply for NOC online.

Documents Requirement for NOC online application

 
      • Copy of Certificate of Nepali Citizenship (clearly visible on both sides), Transcript and Certificate of Educational Qualification one level below the level for which NOC is required for study, Letter mentioning the name of the university to be studied, subject to be studied, total duration of the study program etc. i.e your Offer Letter or Acceptance Letter. (नेपाली नागरिकताको प्रमाणपत्रको प्रतिलिपि (दुबैतर्फ स्पष्ट बुझिने), जुन तह अध्ययनका लागि NOC माग गर्ने हो सोभन्दा एक तह तलकाे शैक्षिक योग्यताको प्रमाण-पत्र, अध्ययन गर्न जाने विश्वविद्यालयको  नाम, अध्ययन गर्ने विषय, अध्ययन गर्ने जम्मा अवधि आदी  उल्लेख भई हस्ताक्षर समेत भएको पत्र |)
      • To study for a Master's degree in Engineering or above, a certificate of registration with the Nepal Engineering Council (NEC) is also required. (ईन्जिनियरिङ तर्फ Master वा सो भन्दा माथिको डिग्री अध्ययन गर्न Nepal Engineering Council (NEC) मा दर्ता भएको प्रमाणपत्र समेत पेश गर्नुपर्ने छ |).If you haven't applied for the Nepal Engineering Council license yet click here for the step-by-step procedure.
      • To study MBBS, you have to submit the Eligibility Letter of the Medical Education Commission and the proof of passing the Entrance Exam. (MBBS  अध्ययन गर्न  Medical Education commissionको Eligibility Letter र Entrance Exam उत्तीर्ण प्रमाण समेत पेश गर्नुपर्ने छ |)
      • To study MD / MS or similar, you need to submit a certificate registered with the Nepal Medical Council (NMC) and an Eligibility Letter from the Medical Education Commission. (MD/MS वा सो सरहको विषय अध्ययन गर्न Nepal Medical Council (NMC)मा दर्ता भएको प्रमाणपत्र र Medical Education commissionको  Eligibility Letter समेत पेश गर्नुपर्ने छ |)
      • The Medical Education Commission's Eligibility Letter must be submitted to study all subjects registered with the Nepal Health Professional Council (NHPC), including BPH / MPH. (BPH/MPH लगायत Nepal Health Professional Council (NHPC) मा दर्ता हुने सम्पूर्ण विषयहरु अध्ययन गर्न समेत Medical Education commissionको  Eligibility Letter पेश गर्नुपर्ने छ |)
      • To study Bachelor / Master subjects from Nursing to Nursing, one has to submit the certificate of registration of Nepal Nursing Council (NNC) and Eligibility Letter of Medical Education Commission. (Nursing बाट Nursing तर्फका Bachelor/Master विषयहरुको अध्ययन गर्न Nepal Nursing Council (NNC) को दर्ता प्रमाणपत्र  तथा Medical Education commissionको  Eligibility Letter समेत पेश गर्नुपर्ने छ | )
      • Generally, NOC will be issued only in the educational programs where the study period is at least 2 years at diploma level, at least 3 years at the undergraduate level and at least 1 year at postgraduate level. (सामान्यतया डिप्लोमा तहमा कम्तिमा २वर्ष ,स्तातक तहमा  कम्तिमा ३ वर्ष र स्नातकोत्तर  तहमा कम्तिमा १ वर्ष  अध्ययन अवधि भएका तथा अध्ययन पश्चात स्तर निर्धारण हुने शैक्षिक कार्यक्रमा मात्र NOC जारी गरिनेछ।)
      • Keep in mind! If NOC is demanded without the above-mentioned documents or if more than one application is made on the same subject, further requests will be rejected. (माथि उल्लिखित कागजपत्र विना NOC माग भएमा वा एउटै बिषयमा एक भन्दा बढी निबेदन गरेमा थप निबेदनहरु अस्वीकृत हुने व्यहोरा सम्बन्धित सबैमा पूर्व जानकारीका लागि अनुरोध छ |)
      • You should visit with the original certificate (including a set of notarized copies) and the documents related to admission to the Foreign Study Permit Branch at Keshar Mahal and once documents are verified in Room No. 3, 4 and 5 you can receive your NOC from Room No. 6. Ministry of Education, Science and Technology (MOEST) has now made it simple and easy to apply for a No Objection Certificate (NOC). Let’s look into the procedures to apply for NOC online through the Government of Nepal, Ministry of Education, Science and Technology NOC online application portal.

Steps for NOC Online Application

  Visit the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology website for NOC. Click here to visit. You will be greeted with a homepage with the option to apply for NOC. Enter your mobile number and hit proceed. Enter OTP(One Time Password) from your mobile phone’s message box and click on the Proceed button. Click on the Resend button if you don't get a message within 2 minutes. Now enter your password, confirm it and click on the submit button Verify your email address and click on the request token. Open Email and enter the email verification token from your email and click on the verify email. Fill in all the fields and upload documents and click on proceed. Add your passport details and click on Confirm. Select your previous academic country. Select your previous Academic level, when selected faculty or stream will appear on the screen and select your stream. Select the country Name from the list in the dropdown menu and the list of colleges will be seen on the screen. Select the college or university from the list. Select Level of study, Stream/faculty and the subject you want to apply to, select self if you're applying yourself or select consultancy if you are applying from consultancy and click on proceed. [Note(only if college, university, subject of your choice ): click on Request New. Type your University name, level, faculty/Stream name subject of your choice and click on request. Else click on Proceed to apply for your NOC and a success message will appear on your screen.
After submitting your online NOC application successfully, you will be notified of the status or outcome of your application through E-mail. If your application is successful, you must submit the application costs by bank transfer.
The day and time of NOC collection will be informed via E-mail. You need to visit Kaeser Mahal and collect your NOC. I hope this article will help you to obtain your NOC. Good Luck!

SEO (Search Engine Optimization) – это комплекс мероприятий, направленных на оптимизацию вебсайта для поисковых с целью усовершенствования его позиций в результатах поиска. Это подключает в себя анализ главных текстов, оптимизацию контента, техно оптимизацию, работу с наружными ссылками и способы, нацеленные на повышение видимости интернет-сайта в поисковых системах. SEO-продвижение сайта является действенным прибором онлайн-продвижения СЕО Продвижение сайта, который помочь взять в долг лучшие позиции следствиях поиска Google. Это кроме содействует расширению мотивированной аудитории, повышению репутации бренда, привлечению качественного трафика на интернет-сайт и увеличению числа заявок и продаж. Этапы SEO-продвижения включают в себя анализ продуктов и предложений проекта, исправление ошибок On-page SEO, работу с лендингами, увеличение их релевантности для определенных групп главных слов, а удаление дублирующихся страничек. Также важным этапом считается выбор доноров и профильное строительство ссылок. SEO-продвижение тоже включает в себя применение инструментов, этих как Netpeak Spider, Google Tag Manager и Measurement Protocol для анализа и усовершенствования характеристик сайта. SEO-продвижение сайта – это главный аспект онлайн-продвижения, кот-ый может улучшить видимость вебсайта в поисковиках и привлечь больше вероятных посетителей.

item.title: Nepal Medical Council (NMC) Registration and License Examination
item.dc:creator: bipin.sharma
item.content:encoded:
The Nepal Medical Council (NMC), which was founded in 2020 BS, is responsible for registering certified doctors and allowing them to practice safe contemporary medicine. The Nepal Medical Council now performs a major role in the country, from registering doctors to conducting licensing exams, monitoring, and regulating medical education. The responsibility of the National Medical Council (NMC) in medical education is being changed to the Health Professional Education Commission (HPEC) with the implementation of the new Health Professional Education Commission (HPEC) Bill. NMC along with the above-mentioned role will also concentrate on the following important areas of work.
  • Medical license examinations and expert examinations should be held to higher standards
  • Establish and enforce medical practitioners' Continuous Professional Development
  • In all aspects of healthcare, NMC will monitor, encourage and enforce the ethical medical practice
Medicine is one of the oldest and most recognized professions; it allows you to affect human life in a really unique way, and the job satisfaction you receive is incomparable. Medicine is a service, not merely a job, in which one must put others first. The hard work and endless hours required to study medicine may appear to be a daunting endeavour, but the ability to save lives is well worth the effort. Nepal produces thousands of doctors every year and there are few who study abroad and become a doctor. To begin their medical professions in Nepal, all MBBS and BDS graduates must pass the Nepal Medical Council licensing exam. Often many find it difficult to register in Nepal Medical Council (NMC) after their graduation due to a lack of clear instructions about the process and the requirements. So, in this article, I will try to cover all aspects one needs to follow and to get registered in NMC. Let’s dive in!

Types of Registration in Nepal Medical Council

The first thing you need to understand is the types of registration and in which category you intend to do registration. There are mainly five types of registration.
  • Provision Registration
  • Temporary Registration
  • Permanent Registration
  • Specialist Registration
  • Foreign Nationals Doctors registration
You need to follow the process according to the type of registration you intend to do.

Steps to Register with Nepal Medical Council

You have to complete the following steps in order to complete your registration and examination process. Before starting the registration process, look into the list of below documents and make sure all these below-listed documents is with you during registration. Documents needed for registration
  • Attested copy of citizenship (both Sides)
  • Passport Size Photo
  • Self-Declaration form (download Self Declaration form, print it, fill details and upload the filled form later)
  • SLC/Equivalent: Marksheet and Character certificate
  •  +2/A-level./Equivalent: Marksheet or Transcript and Character certificate
  • MBBS/BDS/Equivalent: Marksheet/Transcript, Passing/Provisional Certificate, Character Certificate
  • Internship Certificate (Completion of at least 6 Months)
  • Eligibility Certificate (only for students who studied in foreign countries)
  • Native Language (only for students who studied in foreign countries)
  • NMC/Other Medical Council/ Authorized body’s Provisional registration Certificate.
Note: Scan Image must be less than 2 MB. It should be on .gif .jpg .png .jpeg file format.

Let’s look into the steps you need to follow.

You need to visit Nepal Medical Council (NMC) website to do the registration. You can click here to access the registration portal.
  • Once you open the portal, you need to fill in your personal details like name, gender, marital status, email and password. (तपाईंले पोर्टल खोल्नुभएपछि, तपाईंले नाम, लिङ्ग, वैवाहिक स्थिति, इमेल र पासवर्ड जस्ता व्यक्तिगत विवरणहरू भर्नुपर्छ।)
  • The verification link to your email comes after you submit with your email ID and password when applying for an exam. Your ID is ready once it is verified (परीक्षाका लागि आवेदन दिंदा आफ्नो email ID र password सहित SUBMIT गरेपछि तपाईंको email मा verification link आउँछ । त्यसलाई प्रमाणित गरेपछि तपाईंको ID तयार हुन्छ ।)
  • You should go on uploading the information and paperwork as given in the form after logging in with the email and password used during registration. (ID तयार पार्दा प्रयोग भएको email र password राखेर log inगरेपछि फारममा दिएअनुसारको सूचना र कागजपत्रहरु upload गर्दै जानुपर्दछ ।)
  • You will be asked to make payment. You can pay through E-sewa. (तपाईंलाई भुक्तानी गर्न सोधिनेछ। ई-सेवा मार्फत भुक्तानी गर्न सकिन्छ।)
  • The 'verification on process' appears until the form you have submitted isn’t verified by the council, by that time the information can be edited using your ID (तपाईंले बुझाएको फारम काउन्सिलबाट verify नभएसम्म 'verification on process' देखिन्छ, यसबेलासम्म आफ्नो ID प्रयोगगरी सूचनाहरु edit गर्न सकिन्छ ।)
  • After verification, the 'verification on process' disappears and cannot be edited. If you need to edit for some reason, it can be edited once a request has been made to the council via email (nmc@nmc.org.np). (verification भएपछि 'verification on process' देखिन छाड्छ र यसपछि edit गर्न मिल्दैन । कुनै कारणबस edit गर्नु परेमा काउन्सिलको आधिकारीक email (nmc@nmc.org.np)  मा निवेदन दिई अनुमति प्राप्त भएपछि edit गर्न सकिन्छ ।)
  • The council will send an admit card that can be accessed from Action >> Generate Admit Card. You can download it or print it directly. (काउन्सिलबाट प्रवेशपत्र पठाएपछि action मा generate admit card देखिन्छ । त्यसमा थिचेर प्रवेशपत्र download गरी वा नगरी print गर्न सकिन्छ ।)

Photo requirement

Since the photo, you submit when applying for an exam will be printed on your registration certificate, it must be taken within six months, coloured, and seen on a straight camera with both ears visible, eyes open, and passport size that seems clear. If you must wear glasses, they should not be rolled. Except for particularly religious reasons, the head is open and without jewellery, the backdrop is basic and light-coloured, and there is no border.  The face must upload a photo that is proportionally lit, unshadowed, and the eye is not red from the flush, and the focus is mixed.
Fees for different registration and services by Nepal Medical Council is shown in the below image.
 
If you are wondering how to apply for Nepal Engineering Council License and what are the requirements? Please click on this link – Nepal Engineering Council License

Steps after Online Registration

Once you finish online registration, you will receive a verification message from Nepal Medical Council. After that, you have to submit original copies of your documents.
For those who have studied within Nepal:
  • 2 copies of the payment statement paid from E-sewa
  • An application form that is scanned and uploaded during online registration, Self-declaration form, Affidavit and Original Copy of Internship Completion Statement 
  • A copy of the Internship Completion Certificate certified by the Permanent Physician, you also have to self-certify it by writing Sakal Bamojim Nakal Sahi Cha
  • 1 copy of Admit Card of Licensing Exam of Nepal Medical Council
  • Original copy of Provisional Registration Certificate issued by Nepal Medical Council
  • 4 copies of PP size photo uploaded while submitting an online application for registration certificate exam
  • 1 copy of sample Certificate that is automatically generated from the system after the registration application
For those who have studied outside Nepal:
  • 2 copies of the payment statement paid from E-sewa
  • An application form that is scanned and uploaded during online registration, Self-declaration form, Affidavit and Original Copy of Internship Completion Statement 
  • A copy of the Internship Completion Certificate certified by the Permanent Physician, you also have to self-certify it by writing Sakal Bamojim Nakal Sahi Cha
  • 1 copy of Admit Card of Licensing Exam of Nepal Medical Council
  • One copy of all educational qualification certificates obtained above SLC / SEE, eligibility certificate issued by Nepal Medical Council, Internship Completion Certificate and copy of citizenship certified by Permanent Physician, and Self-certified by writing  Sakal Bamojim Nakal Sahi Cha
  • 4 copies of PP size photo uploaded while submitting an online application for registration certificate exam
  • Sample Certificate Print 1 copy automatically generated from the system after the registration application
After above steps
You will receive notification via SMS if your NMC Certificate is ready. If your admit card has to be recovered from the system and printed again, you must deposit Rs.500/- in the Nepal SBI Bank's NMC account. If your NMC Certificate has to be changed or corrected after it has been printed, you must deposit Rs.1000/- in the Nepal SBI Bank's NMC account.   Contact Information of Nepal Medical Council Nepal Medical Council Bansbari, Kathmandu, Nepal. Tel: +977-1-4371954/4377164 FAX: +977-1-4372318 E-mail: nmc@nmc.org.np

item.title: Nepal Nursing Council
item.dc:creator: bipin.sharma
item.content:encoded:
Source: Nepal Nursing Council

  Nepal Nursing Council is an autonomous body established by the Nepal Nursing Council Act 2052, which was enacted by the Government of Nepal with the goal of improving the effectiveness of nursing services in the country, as well as scientific management and mobilization of nurses based on their qualifications.  YouTube Video of Nursing License Exam Online Registration Process Step-by-Step. Click Here:  [embed]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yO0AZXWWbNU[/embed] Nursing in Nepal began in 1956 at Bir Hospital. In Nepal, nursing educational programs such as Auxiliary Nurse Midwife (ANM), Proficiency Certificate Level (PCL), Bachelor of Science in Nursing, Bachelor of Nursing, Master in Nursing, and Master of Science in Nursing are now available. Nepal Nursing Council as part of their goal accredits nursing courses and monitors nursing education facilities in order to provide excellent nursing care to the people of Nepal. All nurses must be registered in order to aid with workforce planning, nurse immigration, and professional misconduct reporting.   Nepal Nursing Council License Exam The license examination for nurses is a national, standardized examination for nurses developed by the Nepal Nursing Council. The test is practical in nature, focusing on the work activities that are most typically needed by entry-level nurses. The exam assesses current medical knowledge and nursing competence, as well as eligibility to get a nurse license and begin working as a nurse. This National Licensure Examination for Nurses is required of all new graduates from the Proficiency Certificate Level (P.C.L.) and Bachelor of Science in Nursing programs (B.Sc.N.). To appear for the National Licensure Examination, you must have graduated or completed your nursing study in P.C.L. or B.Sc. N. Before they may work as a nursing practitioner, all P.C.L. and B.Sc. N graduates must pass the National Licensure Examination.
If you are wondering how to apply for Nepal Engineering Council License and what are the requirements? Please click on this link – Nepal Engineering Council License
  Who can apply for Nepal Nursing Council License? (A) Nepali citizen graduated from Nepal
  • To meet the professional education requirement for licensure as a qualified professional nurse, candidates must present satisfactory evidence of having received at least a four-year degree (B.Sc N.) or 3 years of Proficiency Certificate Level (Diploma level) program that is approved by the Nepal Nursing Council. 
(B) Nepali citizens graduated from other countries 
  • Applicants, who have completed general nursing education out of the country, must have their equivalence certificate from the concerned authority. 
(C) Foreigners graduated from Nepal 
  • Foreign applicants, who have completed a nursing program from Nepal approved by NNC, must submit the required documents. 
(D) Foreigners graduated from other countries
  • A person who was sent from governmental organizations or international cooperation agencies is not required to sit in the National Licensure Examination for Nurses in Nepal.
  • A person, who come to Nepal voluntarily on an individual basis to work, must sit in the National Licensure Examination for Nurses. Person, who stay with tourist visas are not allowed to apply.
Application Procedure You can apply for Nepal Nursing Council License Exam online. To submit your application for the license exam, you can visit this link.
  1. You need to fill in your personal details like name, parents name, DOB, email and password to register yourself.
  2. Once you register, you will receive an email from Nepal Nursing Council with the activation link. Click the link to proceed forward. If you do not find an email in your inbox, check spam.
  3. You need to log in with an email id and password you used to register earlier to lodge your application.
  Documents Requirement The scanned copy of the original should be uploaded while lodging your application. The file should be in image format, for example, .jpg For PCL Nursing
  • Marksheet and character certificate of SLC
  • Citizenship
  • PCL Marksheet or transcript
  • PCL Character certificate
  • Recent passport size photo
For B.Sc. Nursing
  • Marksheet and character certificate of SLC
  • Marksheet or transcript of +2
  • Character certificate of +2
  • B. Sc. Marksheet or transcript
  • B. Sc. Character certificate
  • Citizenship
  • Recent passport size photo
For Foreign Nurse
  • Certificate of nursing education degree
  • Certified copy of a transcript from a nursing degree in original language and Nepali
  • Certificate of home country registration as a nurse
  • Recommendation letter from the organization in which applicant is going to
  • Valid visa or citizenship for applicants who don’t require a visa to enter Nepal
  • Recent passport size photo
Once an application is lodged successfully. Nepal Nursing Council will assess your documents and if all the requirements are fulfilled, you will receive admit/examination card with entry number, date and time of examination. The name of the examination centre will be communicated to you via email 2 days prior to the examination. Note:
  • If you change your name and/or address after submitting an application for licensure, you must notify the NNC immediately in order to document receive current information. You are required to submit legal documentation of any change to the NNC immediately after the change occurs.
  • Your name must match EXACTLY as it appears on photo identification that will be at the test centre. The same name must also be used to the NLEN online at the time you registers in order to prevent delays with issuing examination authorization.
  Information on Nepal Nursing Council License Exam The questions will be objective type - Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs)   Subject Wise Distribution
Subjects Distribution (%) Possible numbers of items
Integrated Science 5 7
Fundamental of Nursing 25 38
Community Health Nursing 15 23
Adult Nursing 20 30
Child Health Nursing 10 15
Midwifery and Gynecology 20 30
Leadership and Management 5 7
Total 150
  Frequency of License Exam
  • The license exam is held three times a year by the Nepal Nursing Council. If an applicant fails one of the exams, he or she will be able to apply for the following one.
Fee
  • The fee for the National Licensure Examination for Nurses is NRs. 1600 which you can pay through E-Sewa. Fees are non-refundable even if an applicant is found ineligible.
Scoring System
  • There is no negative scoring system. It means when you give a wrong answer, there will be no penalty. Marks count for only correct answers.
Passing Standard
  • The grading system on Licensure Examination for Nurses is either Pass or Fail.
  • There will be no numerical score issued. 
  • To pass the National Licensure Examination, the candidate must receive at least 50% of the total marks.
Examination
  • The examination will last two and a half hours (2:30 hours).
  • After 15 minutes after the commencement of the examination, applicants are not permitted to enter the examination room.
  • Applicants are only permitted to leave the room one hour after the test begins.
Nepal Nursing Council Result
  • The result for National Licensure Examination will be published on the same day in case of technical fault may take a week after the examination.
  • The results will be posted on the Nursing Council's notice board as well as on the NNC's website. 
  • The Nursing Council will not contact the candidates personally.
Registration
  • Once you pass NLEN successfully, you can apply for registration to get your nursing license from Nepal Nursing Council.
  • The registration fee is NRs. 800 which you can pay via E-Sewa.
  • Application is required within a month of the NLEN examination result.
  • You need to bring admit cared with two passport size photographs used during registrations.
  • You need to bring original citizenship and documents.
  Nepal Nursing Council License Renewal For Nepal Nursing Council License Renewal you need to submit the following documents.
Items
Number
Application form of NNC, original
1
NNC License - Original
1
Voucher having deposited
NRs. 700 (Seven hundred) [if within 35 days from expiration date]
 OR
NRs. 900 (Nine hundred) [if within 35 to 95 days from expiration date ]
with SBI Bank, Maharajgunj in the name of Nepal Nursing Council on the Current Account No. 20435240100009
1
  Nepal Nursing Council license exam model questions   Nepal Nursing Council contact Number +977-1-4372521 or +977-1-4377214 E-mail: info@nnc.org.np

item.title: VFS Biometric Appointment Australia: All You Need to Know
item.dc:creator: bipin.sharma
item.content:encoded:
Introduction:

In the process of visa application to Australia, certain applicants are required to attend a VFS biometric appointment. This appointment is crucial for verifying the applicant's identity through biometric data like fingerprints and facial recognition. If you're planning to apply for a visa to Australia, understanding the ins and outs of the VFS Biometric Appointment process is essential. This article provides a detailed overview of everything you need to know about VFS Biometric Appointment Australia, helping you navigate the process with ease and confidence. Intersted in VFS Appointment Date Booking? Click the link:  [embed]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZafHeKQfGMU[/embed]

What is a VFS Biometric Appointment?

A VFS Biometric Appointment is an essential step in the Australian visa application process for specific categories of visa applicants. During this appointment, applicants are required to provide their biometric data, including fingerprints and facial recognition, which will be used for identity verification purposes. The biometric data collected is linked to the visa application and plays a crucial role in ensuring the security and integrity of the visa system.

Why is a VFS Biometric Appointment Required?

The Australian government implemented the biometric appointment requirement as part of its efforts to strengthen border security and prevent identity fraud. By capturing biometric data, authorities can accurately verify the identity of visa applicants, making it more challenging for individuals to use fraudulent documents or assume false identities during the application process.

Types of Visas Requiring a VFS Biometric Appointment:

Certain visa categories require applicants to undergo a VFS Biometric Appointment. These visa types include, but are not limited to:
  • Student Visas: Students applying for higher education or vocational courses in Australia.
  • Temporary Work Visas: Individuals applying for temporary work visas, such as subclass 482 and 457 visas.
  • Partner Visas: Spouses or de facto partners of Australian citizens or permanent residents.
  • Family Visas: Dependent family members of Australian citizens or permanent residents.
  • Resident Return Visas: Former Australian permanent residents seeking to return to Australia.
  • Skilled Visas: Applicants applying under skilled migration programs, like the General Skilled Migration (GSM) visa.

VFS Biometric Appointment Process: Step by Step

Understanding the step-by-step process of the VFS Biometric Appointment will help you prepare adequately and ensure a smooth experience. Let's delve into the details:

Step 1: Visa Application Lodgement

Before scheduling a VFS Biometric Appointment, you must first submit your visa application through the official Australian government website or through VFS Global, the official outsourcing partner for visa-related services.

Step 2: Biometrics Request

Once you have lodged your visa application, you will receive a request for biometrics collection if your visa category requires it. The request will contain details on how to schedule your VFS Biometric Appointment.

Step 3: Scheduling the Appointment

You can schedule your VFS Biometric Appointment online through the VFS Global website or by contacting the VFS Global helpline. Select a date and time that is convenient for you and ensure you have all the necessary documents before the appointment.

1. Visit the Official Website:

Go to the official VFS Global website for Australia visa services: https://www.vfsglobal.com/Australia/Nepal/

2. Select Your Visa Type:

Identify your visa type (e.g., student visa, work visa) and gather the necessary documents based on the requirements for that specific visa category.

3. Create an Account:

If you don't have an existing account, create one on the VFS Global website. Log in if you already have an account.

4. Begin the Visa Application Process:

  • Start the visa application process by entering the required information.
  • Fill in all details accurately and thoroughly.

5. Schedule an Appointment:

  • Look for the option to schedule a biometric appointment.
  • Choose a date and time that is convenient for you.

6. Provide Personal Details:

  • Input your personal details, passport information, and visa application reference number.
  • Double-check all information for accuracy.

7. Pay the Biometric Appointment Fee:

  • Pay the biometric appointment fee through the available online payment options.
  • Confirm the payment and check for a receipt.

8. Receive Appointment Confirmation:

  • After successful scheduling and payment, you should receive an appointment confirmation.
  • Verify the details of your appointment in the confirmation.

9. Prepare for the Appointment:

  • Gather all required documents, including your passport, visa application reference number, and appointment confirmation.
  • Dress appropriately, ensuring your face is clearly visible for the photograph.

10. Arrive at the VFS Global Center:

  • Arrive at the VFS Global Center in Nepal at least 15-30 minutes before your scheduled appointment.
  • Present your documents for inspection.

11. Undergo Biometric Enrollment:

  • During the appointment, your fingerprints and a facial photograph will be taken.
  • Follow the instructions of the VFS staff for a smooth process.

12. Additional Assistance:

  • If you encounter any issues or have questions, contact VFS Global support through their helpline or customer service channels.
Remember to check the official VFS Global website for any updates or changes in the application process. Always follow the specific guidelines provided for your visa type and consult with the immigration department for the most accurate and current information.

Step 5: Biometric Data Submission

After the biometric data is collected, it is securely transmitted to the Australian Department of Home Affairs, where it will be linked to your visa application.

Step 6: Wait for the Visa Decision

Once your biometric data is submitted, continue to wait for the Australian authorities to process your visa application. The processing times may vary depending on the type of visa you have applied for.

What to Bring to Your VFS Biometric Appointment?

To ensure a successful VFS Biometric Appointment, make sure to bring the following documents and items:
  • Appointment Confirmation: Print the appointment confirmation and bring it with you.
  • Passport: Carry your valid passport.
  • Biometric Request Letter
  • Demand Draft
  • Photograph: Though a photograph will be taken during the appointment, carry a passport-sized photograph as a backup.

Tips for a Successful VFS Biometric Appointment:

Here are some tips to help you have a smooth and successful VFS Biometric Appointment:
  • Be Punctual: Arrive at the appointment centre on time to avoid any delays.
  • Dress Neatly: Present yourself in a neat and professional manner.
  • Follow Instructions: Listen to the staff's instructions during the appointment.
  • Double-Check Documents: Ensure you have all the required documents before the appointment.
  • Stay Calm: Remain calm and composed during the biometric data collection process.

FAQs (Frequently Asked Questions):

  • 1. What happens if I miss my VFS Biometric Appointment?
    • If you miss your appointment, you may need to reschedule it through the VFS Global website or helpline. Failure to attend the appointment may delay your visa processing.
  • Can someone else attend the VFS Biometric Appointment on my behalf?
    • In most cases, the applicant must attend the appointment in person. However, some exceptions may apply based on specific circumstances.
  • Is there a fee for the VFS Biometric Appointment?
    • Yes, there is usually a fee associated with the VFS Biometric Appointment. The fee may vary depending on the type of visa you are applying for.
  • How long does the biometric data remain valid?
    • Biometric data collected during the appointment is typically valid for a specific period. It may vary depending on the visa subclass and individual circumstances.
  • Can I provide my biometric data at an Australian embassy or consulate in my home country?
    • No, biometric data must be provided at a designated VFS Biometric Collection Center in Australia or an overseas country where you are residing.
  • What if I have a medical condition that affects my fingerprints?
  • If you have a medical condition that affects your ability to provide fingerprints, you should inform the staff during the appointment. They will provide alternative arrangements.

Conclusion:

Attending a VFS Biometric Appointment is an essential part of the visa application process for certain visa categories in Australia. By collecting biometric data, the Australian government ensures the security and integrity of the visa system. This article has provided a comprehensive guide to help you understand the VFS Biometric Appointment process, requirements, and tips for a successful appointment. Remember to follow the guidelines, bring all the necessary documents, and stay calm during the appointment to ensure a smooth experience. Good luck with your visa application journey!

item.title: DAAD In-Region Scholarship Document Preparation
item.dc:creator: bipin.sharma
item.content:encoded:
I hope you have a good understanding of the scholarship, the conditions for eligibility, and the funding by now. If you haven't read the first post about the DAAD In-Region Scholarship yet, I ask you to first go through the previous post before proceeding to the scholarship document preparation. The link to the last post is Here.

Application process

Keep in mind that you have to submit your documents to both DAAD and IIT Bombay simultaneously.

For DAAD, you have to upload some documents in the portal, whereas some documents need to be couriered to the DAAD office, Delhi, before the deadline. The deadline to submit all your documents to DAAD is January 05.

For IIT Bombay, you have to courier all your documents before the deadline. The deadline to submit all your documents to IIT Bombay is January 15.

Documents Requirement

[table id=2 /] Let's explore in-depth on how these documents are prepared, one by one.

Application form

The application form for IIT Bombay can be download from here. Either you can print it and fill it with a pen, or you can edit the application form and fill in your PC and add the date and digital signature.

But, For DAAD, you must register in the DAAD portal first. Use this link to register.

Go to Personal Funding after registration, and click on Application. The application form is available for download from there.

The application form is an editable pdf file. And you can fill in all of your information by simply opening a file in your PDF reader.

Educational documents

You have to submit both DAAD and IIT Bombay the grade transcripts and degree certificates. These include secondary (10th), higher secondary (11th and 12th), bachelor and Master (for PhD), grade transcripts, or mark sheets and certificates

It is recommended that you scan all educational documents listed above and save them in PDF format. In the case of DAAD, you have to access the portal and upload these documents there in PDF format. You have to send a printed copy to IIT Bombay.

In any case, it may be useful in the future when you have scanned and saved it as PDF in the PC.

Curriculum Vitae

For both DAAD and IIT Bombay, Curriculum Vitae is essential. The DAAD recommends preparing a CV in European format. You can visit the Europass website and make your CV. You have to insert your details, and once you added all your details, then you can download and save it on your PC.

Letter of motivation

The letter of motivation (also often referred to as the "statement of purpose") offers an overview of the technical qualifications, personal reasons for choosing to study at chosen university in our case IIT Bombay, and the opportunity to convince committee as to why you are the right candidate. Don't take it as just another document. Quite often, the letter of motivation makes the most significant difference between acceptance and rejection in your admission process.

A letter of motivation is required for both DAAD and IIT Bombay. You can either prepare one for each, or you can make specific to each one. I recommend making a specific one; it does not mean you have to prepare completely distinct. The content may be the same, but the overall theme may be different.

For IIT Bombay, you should, for instance, focus on demonstrating your academic and professional abilities, projects, etc. whereas, for DAAD, you can write balanced one covering academic, professional, extracurricular, plan, etc.

If you want guidelines on how to prepare a letter of motivation, click here to download pdf.

English language certificate

As proof of the English language requirements, both IELTS and TOFEL are accepted.

If you wish to appear for the TOFEL paper-based, the overall score needed is 580, with 4.0 in the writing section. The minimum total score for Internet-based is 95 and 20 in writing.

For IELTS, a total score of 6.5 is required with 6.0 or more in each section.

Test scores more than two years old will not be accepted for consideration.

Recommendation letter

A recommendation letter is another crucial piece of document that can play a major role in your admission or rejection.

For IIT Bombay, three recommendation letters are required, and at least one recommendation should be about your academic performance issued by a faculty member. If you have work experience, you can approach your manager or supervisor for a recommendation. All three can also be from professors. I recommend you contact the professor who taught you courses in which you performed well, and he/she knows you properly.

The letter of recommendation should be signed and stamped by the professor in the official letterhead. The envelope should be sealed.

For DAAD, however, it is different. You should log in to the DAAD portal. Go to Personal funding and click Request for Reference Form. Once you entered the details of your referee, you can download the reference form from the portal.

The reference form consists of a set of questions that your referee needs to answer. The form is in editable PDF format. Once your referee answered the questions in the form, make sure it is signed and stamped by him/her.

You have to send the sealed envelope containing a recommendation letter to the DAAD office, Delhi.

Additional documents

For IIT Bombay

You need to download a personal particulars form for the foreign scholar. You can download it by clicking here.

And the copy of your passport page showing your nationality and personal details is also required.

For DAAD

You should prepare a tentative timeline about what you will be doing in two years or five years, depending on your program Master or PhD. I recommend downloading the course structure and syllabus from your chosen department website.

For Masters students, generally, the first year is course work, and the final year is a research project. For PhD, they have to take some courses to fulfill the mandatory credit requirement. Apart from that, the research work that you and your chosen supervisor agreed for.

The copy of your passport page showing your nationality and personal details is required for DAAD as well.
PhD candidates have to submit the following additional documents:
  • Offer letter issued by IIT Bombay after confirmation of PhD position. Subsequently, the selected candidates are required to submit the 'Declaration of Acceptance' issued by the academic supervisor assigned to them at IIT Bombay
  • Detailed and precise PhD proposal, including detailed work and time table (if applicable: mentioning the planned research stay in Germany, see "Additional benefits")
  • Abstract of the proposal on one page (please include name and title of proposal)

After document preparation

Now, you have prepared all your documents for both DAAD and IIT Bombay.

DAAD

The next thing is to upload the documents in the DAAD portal. The documents you need to upload in the portal are listed below. The deadline to submit all your documents to DAAD is January 05.
  • Duly filled application form
  • 10th mark sheet or transcript and certificate
  • 11th and 12th transcript and certificate
  • Bachelor transcript and degree certificate
  • Master transcript and degree certificate (For PhD)
  • Curriculum Vitae
  • Letter of Motivation
  • IELTS or TOFEL report card
  • Copy of the passport
  • Timeline
  • Work experience certificate if any (optional)
  • Research proposal (for PhD)
  • One page Abstract with name and title (for PhD)

Once you upload the above documents application summary will be generated in the portal. Which you have to download and print a copy of it.

The printed copy of your application summary and a sealed envelope containing your recommendation letter need to be sent via courier to DAAD office Delhi. Address of DAAD office Delhi German Academic Exchange Service (DAAD) 3rd Floor, South Block DLTA Complex R.K. Khanna Stadium 1 Africa Avenue New Delhi – 110029 Mrs. Pooja Midha Board Number: +91 11 66465500, Ext 511 Direct Number: +91 11 66465511 E-mail: midha@daaddelhi.org

IIT Bombay

Similarly, the documents you need to send by post to IIT Bombay are listed below. The deadline to submit all your documents to IIT Bombay is January 15.
  • Duly filled application form
  • 10th mark sheet or transcript and certificate
  • 11th and 12th transcript and certificate
  • Bachelor transcript and degree certificate
  • Master transcript and degree certificate (For PhD)
  • Curriculum Vitae
  • Statement of purpose
  • IELTS or TOFEL report card
  • Copy of the passport
  • Duly filled personal particulars form for a foreign scholar
  • Work experience certificate if any (optional)
  • Three recommendation letters in a sealed envelope
  • Research proposal (For PhD)
Address to send your documents for IIT Bombay Dy. Registrar / Asst. Registrar (Academic) Academic Section, 2nd floor, Main Building, IIT Bombay, Powai, Mumbai – 400 076 Maharashtra, India. Ph.: +91 - 22 - 2576 7041 / 7044

You can track your document using tracking id to monitor your courier status. Alternatively, after sending your documents just drop a mail to the program coordinators stating that you have sent your documents by post and request them to send a document received mail.

Besides, I also request you all to please check the official website of both DAAD Delhi and IIT Bombay as the document requirements change from time to time. You can click the link below to go to the official website.

DAAD | IIT Bombay

What after submission of documents?

The program coordinator will review your documents in the Academic section at IIT Bombay. If you meet the minimum requirements, then your documents will be forwarded for review to the relevant department.

Based on the history of students admitted under DAAD scholarship at IIT Bombay, Master Students may or may not receive an interview call. Preparing for an interview is safer, though. The interview aims to assess your academic and technical skills and to ensure you are the right applicant for the program.

But in the case of PhD, you'll definitely get a call for an interview. I suggest that you prepare for an interview thoroughly, review your research proposal several times, review some fundamentals relevant to your research, and some general questions.

If your application is successful, you will receive an offer from IIT Bombay in February or March.

After you receive your offer, send your offer to the program coordinator at DAAD office, Delhi.

You can check your scholarship application status in the DAAD portal. Mostly the selection result is out at the end of May or June.

Final thoughts

So, I hope this post will help you to prepare your document smoothly and answer your doubt regarding document preparation. Still, if you have any queries which are unanswered in the above post, please drop a mail. You can drop an email visiting the contact me page. If the above post helped you to get an offer and scholarship, please comment below. It will be highly appreciated.

If you received an offer from IIT Bombay and a scholarship from DAAD, please read my other posts. It might be helpful for you.

   

Disclaimer: This post herein is those of the author; it does not necessarily reflect the views of the DAAD. The sole purpose of this post is to help readers about the document preparation for scholarship and how they can approach the smooth application process.

item.title: Passport Form Online Application in Nepal
item.dc:creator: bipin.sharma
item.content:encoded:
In the digital age, where convenience is key, even the process of obtaining essential documents like passports has undergone a significant transformation. Gone are the days of cumbersome paperwork and long queues. This article delves into the world of passport form online application in Nepal, shedding light on the evolution of the application process and the myriad benefits it brings to applicants. तपाईंको मोबाइल वा कम्प्युटरबाटै ई-पासपोर्ट सजिलैसित अनलाइन फारम आवेदन स्टेप बाइ स्टेप भर्न यो युट्युब भिडियो (Youtube Video) अन्तिम सम्म हेर्नु होला। [embed]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YV0W6iDRRo0[/embed]   Traditional Passport Application Process in Nepal In the not-so-distant past, securing a passport in Nepal involved navigating a labyrinth of paperwork. Applicants were required to fill out lengthy forms, submit numerous documents physically, and endure prolonged waiting periods. The traditional approach posed challenges, from the risk of document misplacement to the inconvenience caused to applicants. Evolution of Passport Application The advent of passport form online application systems marked a turning point. This approach not only streamlined the entire process but also introduced efficiency and accessibility. With just a few clicks, applicants could initiate the passport acquisition journey from the comfort of their homes. Navigating the Online Portal To embark on the online passport application journey, applicants need to familiarize themselves with the user-friendly online portal. Navigating the portal is a straightforward process, ensuring that even those less tech-savvy can successfully complete their applications. You can visit passport form online application website of Government of Nepal. Step 1: Identify your Passport Form Online Application Requirement You will have four options available on the website.
  1. First Issuance (For First Time Application)
  2. Renewal (To Renew Passport)
  3. Replacement (Lost/Stolen)
  4. Replacement (Damaged)
[caption id="attachment_942" align="alignleft" width="300"] Passport Options[/caption] If you are applying for the first time, you should select option one. If your passport expired then you should go for second option to renew your passport. In case of lost or stolen passport, you should apply with third option and if your passport details are incorrect or your passport is damaged, you can apply using fourth option.   Step 2: Filling out the Application Form In this step, you should select type of passport requirement and proceed ahead with application. The passport form online application requires detailed information, such as Demographic Information (Name, Gender, Date of Birth, Parents Details, etc.), Citizenship Information (National identity document number, Citizenship number, Issue date, Issue district, etc.), Applicant's Contact Details (Phone number, Email, etc.) and Emergency Contact Details (Name, Address, Phone, E-mail, etc.). Carefully fill all the details. Step 3: Uploading Documents A crucial aspect of the online application is the submission of essential documents. This section outlines the documents required and provides guidelines on scanning and uploading them to ensure the accuracy and completeness of the application. If you are applying for the first time, the document required for passport form online application are: 1. Citizenship Front Photo 2. Citizenship Back Photo 3. Rastriya Parichaya Patra (National Identity Document) Photo If you are married and plan to apply for passport for your spouse. 4. Marrige Certificate (Optional) If you are applying for renewal of your passport. 5. Previous/old passport details page photo Step 4: Payment Process With the traditional hurdles of manual payment removed, the online passport application allows for secure and convenient transactions. Various payment options are available, catering to the diverse needs of applicants. You can pay online however if you wish to pay physically, you can do so as well visiting District Administration Office. Step 5: Application Submission and Tracking Once the application is filled out and documents are uploaded, applicants can submit their forms online. Your fully filled e-passport pdf will generate and you can download it once you submit your application. Print that pdf and along with that take your citizenship and National identity document copy and submit it to District Administration Office. You can download passport tracking application on your phone. The tracking feature enables you to monitor the progress of your application, providing peace of mind throughout the waiting period. Step 6: Bio-metric and Photographs Once you submit and pay your passport application charge you should visit District Administration Office and provide them bio-metric and photographs. After that it may take from 15 days to 30 days to receive your passport. You will receive a message on your phone when to go to collect your passport.
Looking for VFS appointment? Read this detailed article: VFS Biometric Appointment Australia: All You Need to Know - AcadBuddy
Benefits of Online Passport Application in Nepal The online passport application process offers numerous advantages. Time and cost efficiency top the list, as applicants no longer need to spend hours traveling and waiting in lines. The reduced chance of errors in the online process further adds to its appeal. Common Mistakes to Avoid Despite the simplicity of the online application, certain mistakes are common. This section highlights these errors and offers preventive measures to ensure a smooth and error-free process. Security Measures in Online Passport Application Security is a top priority in the online passport application system. Robust security measures are in place to safeguard applicant data, reassuring individuals about the confidentiality and protection of their sensitive information. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) Q1: Can I apply for a passport online if I'm residing outside of Nepal? A1: Yes, the online passport application system is accessible to Nepali citizens worldwide. If you are abroad and need to renew your passport, you can do so visiting Nepalese Embassy in that country. Ensure you provide accurate international contact details during the application process. Q2: How long does it take to process an online passport application? A2: The processing time varies (15 to 30 days) but is generally faster than traditional methods. You can track the status of your application online for real-time updates. Q3: What happens if I make a mistake in my online application? A3: The system allows you to review and edit your information before submission. However, it's crucial to double-check your details to avoid errors. Q4: Is the online payment process secure? A4: Yes, the online payment system is secure, employing encryption technology to ensure the confidentiality of your financial information. Q5: Can I cancel my online passport application after submission? A5: Once an application is submitted, it cannot be canceled. Ensure all information is accurate before finalizing the submission. Conclusion In conclusion, the passport form online application process in Nepal has revolutionized how citizens obtain this essential travel document. Embracing technology has not only simplified the process but has also made it more efficient and secure. As we bid farewell to the era of paperwork and long queues, the online application system stands as a beacon of progress. Unique FAQs After The Conclusion Q6: Can I apply for a passport online on behalf of a minor? A6: Yes, parents or legal guardians can apply for a passport on behalf of a minor child through the online application system. Additional documentation may be required. Q7: What should I do if I encounter technical issues during the online application process? A7: In case of technical issues, reach out to the designated support channels provided on the passport application website for assistance. Q8: Are there any restrictions on the types of photos accepted for the online application? A8: Yes, the online system has specific guidelines for passport photos. Ensure your photo meets the specified requirements to avoid processing delays. Q9: Can I pay the passport application fee in installments? A9: No, the online payment system requires the full fee

item.content:encoded:
Introduction

In the digital age, navigating through government procedures has become more convenient than ever. One such process is obtaining the Rastriya Parichaya Patra, and the online form application has streamlined this task for many. In this comprehensive guide, we will walk you through the intricacies of the Rastriya Parichaya Patra online form application, providing invaluable insights and tips to make the process seamless.  
राष्ट्रिय परिचयपत्र सजिलैभर्ने तरिका YouTube Video:
[embed]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i8ZtS5VrIJo[/embed]

Understanding the Importance of Rastriya Parichaya Patra

What is Rastriya Parichaya Patra?

The Rastriya Parichaya Patra, often referred to as the National Identity Card, holds significant importance in various aspects of an individual's life. From official transactions to establishing one's identity, this document plays a crucial role. With the advent of technology, the online application process has become the preferred method for many.

Step-by-Step Guide to Rastriya Parichaya Patra Online Form Application

1. Accessing the Official Website

Begin the application process by navigating to the official website. Make sure you are on the secure and official portal to avoid any discrepancies in the application. Here is the link for NID Pre-Enrollment.

2. Registration Process

You will have two options displayed in the website, they are, Login for Individuals and Login for Service Providers. You should select first option Login for Individuals to move ahead with your Rastriya Parichaya Patra form application. Once you click login, you need to enter your mobile number. 4 digits One time password (OTP) will be sent to your mobile phone. You need to enter the 4 digits code received on your phone inorder to move ahead with the application.

3. Filling Out Personal Information

After verification of OTP you will be greeted with the portal which allows you to proceed for new enrollment. Carefully fill in your personal details, including name, date of birth, address, Parents and grand parents information and other pertinent information. Accuracy at this stage is paramount to avoid delays or issues in the verification process.

4. Reviewing and Submitting

In this step, select your District Administration Office (DAO) from the list. If your DAO is not shown in the list, you should select Others option. Thoroughly review the information provided before submitting the form. This step is crucial in minimizing errors and ensuring that your application is complete and accurate. After you submit your application, print a copy of it and bring it DAO office when you attend for biometric submission.
Worried about passport application? Read this detailed article: Passport Form Online Application in Nepal - AcadBuddy

Tips for a Successful Rastriya Parichaya Patra Application

1. Double-Check Information

Before submitting your application, take the time to double-check all the entered information. This not only expedites the verification process but also reduces the chances of errors.

2. Stay Informed about Updates

Keep yourself informed about any updates or changes in the application process. Regularly check the official website or subscribe to notifications to stay ahead of any modifications.

3. Utilize Helpline Services

If you encounter any difficulties during the application process, don't hesitate to reach out to the dedicated helpline services. The support team is there to assist you and ensure a smooth experience.

Conclusion

In conclusion, the Rastriya Parichaya Patra online form application is a user-friendly and efficient way to obtain your National Identity Card. By following the step-by-step guide and implementing the provided tips, you can navigate the process effortlessly. Stay informed, provide accurate information, and make the most of the convenience offered by online applications.

item.title: SSW Visa Japan from Nepal
item.dc:creator: bipin.sharma
item.content:encoded:
Dreaming of working abroad in Japan? As a Nepali citizen, your aspirations are within reach through the SSW Visa Japan from Nepal program. Japan's rich culture, advanced technology, and booming economy make it an enticing destination for skilled workers from around the globe. In this comprehensive guide, we'll walk you through everything you need to know about obtaining an SSW Visa Japan from Nepal in 2024, from eligibility requirements to the application process. SSW working visa YouTube Video, Step-by-step: [embed]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8OpIN7PKllY&t=1s[/embed] Japan Working Visa from Nepal and how to apply ssw visa in Japan.

Understanding the SSW Working Visa

The Specified Skilled Worker (SSW) visa is designed to address Japan's labor shortages in specific industries by welcoming foreign workers with specialized skills. Introduced in 2019, this visa category offers opportunities for individuals from Nepal and other countries to contribute to Japan's workforce while experiencing its unique culture.

Eligibility Criteria

To qualify for the SSW Visa Japan from Nepal, applicants must meet certain criteria:

1. Japanese Language Proficiency

While not mandatory for all industries, a basic understanding of the Japanese language is often required. Some employers may provide language training upon arrival, but most of them ask for a candidate who have JFT (Japan Foundation Test for Basic Japanese) or JLPT (Japanese Language Proficiency Test) N4 level proficiency. So, start studying Japanese language in an institute or consultancy. Japanese language levels range from N5 to N1, N5 being basic and N1 being near to natives.

2. Skill Proficiency of SSW Japan Visa

Applicants must possess skills and experience relevant to industries experiencing labor shortages in Japan, such as nursing, construction, hospitality, and information technology. You need to appear for skill test which will be held online. You need to pass the online skill test to proceed for further process.

3. Job Search and Offer Acceptance

Begin by exploring job opportunities in Japan through online platforms, recruitment agencies, or direct contact with employers. Once you receive a job offer, carefully review the terms and conditions before accepting. A valid job offers from a Japanese employer registered with the Specified Skilled Worker system is essential. Employer may conduct an interview to know details about you and your experience. This may be a single interview or multiple interviews. Once you passed an interview employer will issue you an Employment Contract. Some employers may also ask for medical report before finalizing employment contract. You need to do your medical checkup and submit them the report. Employment offer typically includes details of the position, salary, and working conditions.

4. Clean Criminal Record

Applicants must demonstrate a clean criminal record and adhere to Japan's laws and regulations throughout their stay.

5. Certificate of Eligibility (COE)

Company will submit all your documents to the regional immigration for COE. It may take around 1.5 to 2 months. Regional Immigration will do evaluation of all the documents submitted and make a decision whether to issue COE or not. If they issue COE, regional immigration will send your COE to employer and employer will send it to you. Original COE or digitally verified COE is necessary to apply for Visa in Nepal. Japan Working Visa from Nepal and how to apply ssw visa in Japan.

Visa Application Process

Securing an SSW Working Visa from Nepal involves several steps:

1. SSW Japan Visa from Nepal Document Preparation

Gather the necessary documents, including a valid passport, COE, passport-sized photos, educational certificates, proof of work experience, and a clean criminal record certificate. Some professions may require additional certifications or licenses.

2. VFS Application

All the Japan visas related process for example, document check, submission of document to embassy, passport submission, passport collection is handled by VFS Global that is located in Chaya Devi Complex, Thamel, Kathmandu. Firstly, you need to take VFS appointment online. In the selected date and time, visit VFS office and submit your visa application to them. Ensure all documents are accurately completed and provide any additional information requested by the authorities.

3. Interview and Screening

Depending on the visa category and industry, applicants may be required to undergo an interview or skills assessment to evaluate their suitability for the position.

5. Visa Issuance

Upon successful review of your application, the Japanese authorities will issue your SSW Working Visa, allowing you to travel to Japan and commence employment.

Benefits of the SSW Visa Japan from Nepal

Obtaining an SSW Working Visa offers numerous advantages:

1. Employment Opportunities

Access to a wide range of job opportunities in industries facing labor shortages, with the potential for career advancement and skill development.

2. Cultural Immersion

Experience Japan's rich cultural heritage, traditions, and way of life while living and working in the country.

3. Financial Stability

Competitive salaries and benefits provided by Japanese employers ensure financial stability and security for visa holders and their families. Japan Working Visa from Nepal and how to apply ssw visa in Japan.

Reaching in Japan

You need to do the following activities.
  1. Attend life orientation provided by the accept organization.
  2. Register as a resident in the municipalities in which you live.
  3. Open a salary bank account.
  4. Secure housing, etc.

Conclusion

The SSW Working Visa presents an exciting opportunity for Nepali citizens to pursue their career aspirations in Japan. By meeting the eligibility criteria and following the application process diligently, you can embark on a rewarding journey of professional growth and cultural exchange. Start your journey today and unlock a world of opportunities in Japan!

A: แม้ว่าผลส่วนใหญ่จะขึ้นอยู่กับโชค แต่การเรียนรู้กฎ การจัดการงบประมาณที่มีประสิทธิภาพ และการตัดสินใจกิจกรรมที่มีอัตราการคืนทุนน่าสนใจจะช่วยต่อยอดช่องทางในการได้กำไร ประสบการณ์จากผู้เล่นที่มีประสบการณ์ Li Wei จากจีน: "ผมได้ทดลองคาสิโนออนไลน์มานานหลายปี และเห็นว่าการตัดสินใจเว็บไซต์ที่ปลอดภัยคือสิ่งสำคัญอย่างยิ่ง การควบคุมงบอย่างเข้มงวดทำให้ผมรื่นรมย์กับการเล่นได้อย่างยั่งยืน" Kim Jisoo จากเกาหลีใต้: "ดิฉันชอบสล็อตออนไลน์อย่างมาก เพราะว่ามันไม่ซับซ้อนและน่าตื่นเต้น แนวทางของดิฉันคือ ตัดสินใจสล็อตที่มีโบนัสหลากหลาย และอย่าคาดหวังแจ็คพอตมูลค่าสูงเกินไป" Tanaka Hiroshi จากญี่ปุ่น: "แทงบอลออนไลน์ส่งผลให้การชมฟุตบอลมีสีสันยิ่งขึ้นสำหรับผม การประเมินข้อมูลทีมอย่างครอบคลุมและไม่อาศัยอารมณ์ในการวางเดิมพันคือหัวใจสำคัญ" จุดบวกและจุดด้อยของการเดิมพันสล็อตออนไลน์ ประเด็นเด่น: ความคล่องตัว - สามารถเดิมพันได้ทุกตำแหน่งทุกโอกาส ความหลากหลายของเกมและตัวเลือกการเดิมพัน ข้อเสนอพิเศษและโปรโมชันนานาชนิด ประสบการณ์การพนันที่เหมือนจริงด้วยนวัตกรรมทันสมัย มีทางเลือกในการเติมและโอนเงินออกที่นานาชนิด ข้อควรพิจารณา: ความเสี่ยงต่อการเสพติดหากไม่มีขอบเขตตนเองที่ดี ความเป็นไปได้ในการเสียเงินเงินอย่างมากหากไม่มีแผนการที่รัดกุม ความกังวลเรื่องการป้องกันของข้อมูลหากเลือกแพลตฟอร์มที่ไม่ได้มาตรฐาน อาจเกิดความยุ่งยากทางระเบียบกฎหมายในบางท้องที่หรือพื้นที่การบริหาร ผลทางสังคมและมิตรภาพหากเสียเวลาเกินควรกับการเดิมพัน บทส่งท้ายส่งท้ายสำหรับแทงบอลออนไลน์ คาสิโนออนไลน์ แทงบอลออนไลน์ และสล็อตออนไลน์มอบความรู้สึกความบันเทิงและช่องทางในการสร้างผลตอบแทนที่น่าดึงดูด แต่ก็มาพร้อมกับหน้าที่และความเสี่ยงที่ผู้ใช้บริการพึงตระหนัก การพิจารณาแพลตฟอร์มที่ได้มาตรฐาน การเล่นอย่างมีสติ และการดูแลจุดกึ่งกลางในชีวิตเป็นสิ่งจำเป็นที่จะทำให้ประสบการณ์การพนันออนไลน์เป็นสิ่งที่น่าเพลิดเพลินและไว้วางใจได้ในระยะยาว
